pages.title: Titanotylopus
pages.text: The Titanotylopus ($(o)Titanotylopus nebraskensis$()) is an extinct giant camel that lived in North America from the Pliocene into the Pleistocene.$(br2)It was one of the largest camels that ever lived, standing around three metres or more at the shoulder.$(br2)Its long limbs carried a body far heavier than any living camel, and its skull bore large canine teeth.
